text:
1. THE FACILITY
The Lender agrees to advance to the Borrower a sum of Rs. 5,00,000 repayable over thirty-six months.
heading: 1. THE FACILITY

text:
2. INTEREST
Interest shall accrue at a rate determined by the Lender from time to time at its sole discretion, without reference to any published benchmark.
heading: 2. INTEREST

text:
3. DEFAULT INTEREST
In the event of any delay in payment, the Borrower shall pay penal interest at the rate of twenty-four percent per annum, which shall be added to the applicable rate of interest and compounded monthly.
heading: 3. DEFAULT INTEREST

text:
4. PENAL CHARGES
Penal charges shall be levied as the Lender may decide. The Lender is not required to disclose the quantum of such charges in advance.
heading: 4. PENAL CHARGES

text:
5. ACCELERATION
Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default the entire outstanding shall become immediately due and payable without any notice or demand whatsoever.
heading: 5. ACCELERATION

text:
6. SET-OFF
The Lender may at any time and without notice set off any sum due hereunder against any credit balance in any account of the Borrower held with the Lender.
heading: 6. SET-OFF

text:
7. PREPAYMENT
The Borrower shall pay a prepayment penalty of four percent of the outstanding principal on any early repayment.
heading: 7. PREPAYMENT

text:
8. SECURITY AND REPOSSESSION
The Lender may repossess the secured asset without prior notice to the Borrower on any default.
heading: 8. SECURITY AND REPOSSESSION
